description: A ghostwritten piece must use South African English spelling throughout, never the US -ize/-or variants, regardless of how the sourced quote itself is worded.

input.sourced_opinion_or_quote: We productised what used to be a bespoke six-month build, and it changed how fast we can move.

rubric.condition: The output contains zero occurrences of any of: organization, optimize, behavior, analyze, center.
The post body contains the exact string Productised speed, matching the pillar supplied in the input.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md hard rule 6 (South African English).
